h1: Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 — a 3-star design hotel with a rooftop pool, free tuk-tuk, and real value in Asok
intro: When travellers look for a genuine design hotel with a rooftop pool in the Asok-Sukhumvit area without paying luxury-hotel rates, Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 is the name that keeps coming up in real guest reviews. A 195-room, dark-toned design hotel on Sukhumvit Soi 15 — originally opened in 1996 as the Dream Hotel Bangkok, and substantially renovated in 2022 — it offers a rooftop outdoor pool with Jacuzzi, Coran Boutique Spa, a 24-hour gym, and a breakfast buffet at Flava Restaurant, all topped off with a complimentary tuk-tuk shuttle to BTS Asok, MRT Sukhumvit and Terminal 21. Rooms start from approx. THB 1,800/night, with a score of 8.7 from 4,380 Booking.com reviews — unusually strong for a 3-star property in this location.

body.html: Night Hotel Bangkok has accumulated one of the heaviest review bases of any 3-star property in Sukhumvit — more than 4,380 verified reviews on Booking.com and over 4,100 on TripAdvisor (rated 4.4 out of 5, ranking in the top 250 of roughly 1,400 Bangkok hotels). That volume of feedback makes the verdict unusually reliable: reviewers consistently flag rooms that feel bigger than the price suggests, staff who go noticeably out of their way, a breakfast spread that punches above the 3-star norm, and a rooftop pool that genuinely surprises guests who were not expecting it at this price point.

The hotel sits on Sukhumvit Soi 15, a relatively quiet side street that gives you a moment's respite from the main road's bustle while keeping everything within easy reach. Terminal 21 shopping mall is roughly 450 metres away on foot. BTS Asok and MRT Sukhumvit are about a 10-minute walk, but the hotel runs a complimentary tuk-tuk shuttle to both stations and to Terminal 21 throughout the day — a touch that reviewers appreciate particularly when returning late from the Asok-Nana area and not wanting to negotiate with taxis.
"Room was much larger than expected, spotlessly clean, and the staff were genuinely helpful with everything. The rooftop pool made it feel far better value than a typical 3-star hotel."

Rooms are spread across 12 categories in two buildings, ranging from Bronze Queen and Silver King through Gold King and Platinum Suite to Family Connecting rooms. All come with the hotel's signature dark-toned design aesthetic, 42-inch flat-screen TVs, allergen-free pillows, a minibar, a work desk and free Wi-Fi. Gold and above offer more floor area and better city views. The consistent refrain in reviews is that room size exceeds expectations for the Sukhumvit price bracket — a practical point worth noting when comparing with neighbours that charge similar rates for much tighter spaces.

The rooftop pool runs 08:00–22:00 daily, with a Jacuzzi, sun loungers and the Flava Lite Rooftop Pool Bar for drinks with a city view. The Coran Boutique Spa offers aromatherapy, Thai massage and Ayurvedic treatments across five treatment rooms. A 24-hour gym serves early risers and late-night exercisers equally. Breakfast at Flava Restaurant — a broad buffet on the second floor with views over the city — receives consistent praise for variety and freshness, well above what most 3-star hotels in Bangkok deliver.

There are a few things worth knowing before you book. The pool, gym and Coran Spa are in Building 2, across the street from the main building — a short walk, but reviewers who did not know this ahead of time found it mildly surprising. Early check-in is charged at approximately THB 1,500–1,600 even when rooms are available, which some reviewers found steep. A number of guests mention that the mattresses are on the soft side — if you prefer a firmer bed, flag it at check-in and staff will try to accommodate. The walk to BTS Asok is around 10 minutes, which in Bangkok's heat is meaningful — the free tuk-tuk solves this effectively.

Overall, Night Hotel Sukhumvit 15 makes a strong case for being the best-value design hotel with a pool in the Asok-Sukhumvit corridor. Whether you are here for one night between legs of a trip, using it as a base for several days of exploring, or simply want a stylish address in a neighbourhood where mid-range accommodation is rarely this polished, the combination of design credentials, a genuine rooftop pool, attentive service and a score of 8.7 from over 4,000 reviewers represents value that is genuinely hard to find in this part of the city.

honestSummary: Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 is one of the most compelling value stays in the Asok-Sukhumvit corridor — a rooftop pool, spa, free tuk-tuk, larger-than-expected rooms and a score of 8.7 from 4,380+ verified reviews all at a genuinely 3-star price. The main caveats are that the pool is in a separate building across the street, and the mattresses lean soft.

tips.title: Use the free tuk-tuk every time
tips.body: The hotel's complimentary tuk-tuk runs to BTS Asok, MRT Sukhumvit and Terminal 21 throughout the day. Check the schedule with Front Desk at check-in — particularly useful late at night when you don't want to negotiate with taxis.

tips.title: Pool is in Building 2 — know this in advance
tips.body: The rooftop pool, Jacuzzi, gym and Coran Spa are in Building 2 across the street from the main building. It is a short walk and not inconvenient, but guests who do not know this ahead of time are occasionally surprised. Pool hours: 08:00–22:00 daily.

tips.title: Breakfast before 08:30 gets the freshest spread
tips.body: Flava Restaurant's buffet is at its best early. Arriving before 08:30 gives you the freshest dishes and fewer crowds, particularly during high season when the hotel runs full. If your rate includes breakfast, it is genuinely worth the early start.

tips.title: Terminal 21 is basically next door
tips.body: Terminal 21 Asok is around 450 metres from the hotel — an easy walk or a free tuk-tuk ride. It has a well-stocked supermarket, a cheap food court, and dozens of casual dining options, making it convenient for any meal of the day.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15

faq.q: Where is Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15, and how close is it to the BTS?
faq.a: The hotel is at 10 Sukhumvit Soi 15, Watthana, Bangkok. BTS Asok and MRT Sukhumvit are roughly a 10-minute walk, but the hotel runs a complimentary tuk-tuk shuttle to both stations and to Terminal 21 throughout the day, so the distance is rarely a practical issue.

faq.q: Where is the pool at Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15?
faq.a: The rooftop outdoor pool, Jacuzzi and Flava Lite Rooftop Pool Bar are in Building 2, across the street from the main building. It is a short walk and perfectly accessible, but it is worth knowing in advance. Pool hours: 08:00–22:00 daily.

faq.q: How much does Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 cost per night?
faq.a: Nightly rates start from approx. THB 1,800 for a Bronze Queen or Silver King room outside peak season. A Gold King runs around THB 2,200, and the Platinum Suite starts from about THB 3,800. Prices vary by date and platform — compare Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com for the best rate.

faq.q: Does Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 allow pets?
faq.a: Yes. The hotel welcomes dogs and cats at no extra charge, making it one of the few pet-friendly hotels in this price range on Sukhumvit.

faq.q: Who is Night Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 best suited for?
faq.a: It is ideal for travellers who want a genuine design hotel with a rooftop pool and spa, at a 3-star price, in a central Asok location. Whether you are staying one night or a week, solo, as a couple or with friends, the combination of thoughtful design, capable staff and a score of 8.7 from 4,380+ reviews makes it one of the most reliable value stays in the area.
